text:
sre-jay: Pager fired — geo-steer deviation detected. ~40% of EU traffic is being routed to us-east1 instead of eu-west2; EU p95 latency jumped to 520ms and we're seeing customer 5xxs. paging incidents channel and SRE oncall.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3091, severity: P1. Paging: @sre-oncall-maria. Runbook: /runbooks/geo-steer-deviation.md :rotating_light:
sre-oncall-maria: I'm on it. Pulling console, checking steering-controller and recent policy rollouts. tagging eng-runtime-ana and platform-lead-chen.
eng-runtime-ana: Noted — telemetry shows a policy deploy at 03:12 UTC that changed splay-window from 30s -> 60s. Also seeing a flurry of region-heartbeat warnings.
support-kyle: multiple EU customer tickets (ACCT-1234, ACCT-5678, ACCT-8901) reporting slow api responses and intermittent 504s starting ~03:14 UTC.
sre-jay: Can someone dump the steering policy history and last-applied annotations? I suspect a race in pin-backoff + splay.
platform-lead-chen: We can apply a temporary static pin to eu-west2 to pull traffic back. Need oncall to approve and execute; will be a manual change to regional-affinity table.
sre-oncall-maria: Approved — executing manual pin now. Command: ```
# apply static pin to eu-west2 for region-affinity
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/api/affinity/pin" -d '{"region":"eu-west2","scope":"all","ttl":900}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
sre-oncall-maria: Pin command executed, status=202. Monitoring effect.
eng-runtime-ana: Observability: within ~30s we see eu-west2 hit-rate increase to ~92% and us-east1 drop. EU p95 trending down to ~130ms.
sre-jay: Good. Hold all steering-related deployments until we understand root cause. I'll grab routing logs and heartbeat timelines.
deploy-bot: Latest steering-policy deployment (id: sp-2026-9043) rolled at 03:12 UTC by eng-runtime-ana. No additional deploys in queue.
sre-oncall-maria: Can everyone add customer impact notes here for post-incident summary. I'll prepare an exec summary and handoff.
support-kyle: Impact summary: peak affected requests ~3.2k req/min, ~12 customers saw elevated latency, 2 customers reported 5xx spikes (~6 minutes each). No auth/data integrity issues reported.
sre-jay: From logs: sample lines -> `route-splay: heartbeat-mismatch region=eu-west2 last_hb=3091234201 expected_grace<=3091234140`. Looks like heartbeat TTL was stricter than the splay window, causing controller to believe eu-west2 was unhealthy briefly and oversteer.
eng-runtime-ana: That matches: splay-window increased to 60s but heartbeat grace stayed at 30s; when transient packet loss delayed a heartbeat by ~40s the controller triggered fallback to other regions. Fixes: (1) align heartbeat grace with splay window, (2) add exponential backoff to pin change frequency, (3) add stricter canary for policy rollout.
platform-lead-chen: I'll schedule a config roll after RCA. For now manual pin is in place (ttl=900s). We should monitor for reversion issues.
sre-oncall-maria: Created follow-up Jira: RED-9382 (steering-controller: heartbeat-splay mismatch + pin-backoff). Linked incidents/inc-2026-3091 and customer tickets.
incident-bot: Severity transitioned: P1 -> P2 (mitigated) at 03:22 UTC.
sre-oncall-maria: Handing off to night oncall @sre-night-tom in ~20m. Current status: manual pin applied, traffic normalized, telemetry stable for 10m. Root cause suspected steering config mismatch. Action items in Jira.
sre-night-tom: ACKed. I'll keep monitoring through the night and escalate if anything reappears. Please paste final customer-impact table in the ticket.
sre-jay: Final notes for RCA: cause = misaligned heartbeat TTL vs splay-window after a policy change; immediate mitigation = manual regional pin; long-term fixes = config defaults and rollout guardrails.
support-kyle: I'll update affected customers with timeline and apology; will track SLA implications.
eng-runtime-ana: Adding automated alert to detect heartbeat vs splay drift.
sre-oncall-maria: Closing incident channel for now and moving to post-incident RCA doc. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: :coffee:
